responsibility: Implements a substantial subset of Intel SSE4.1 intrinsics for the rs6000 x86-compatibility layer. It maps rounding, blend, compare, min/max, multiply, sign/zero extension, insertion/extraction, dot-product, minpos, and related integer/vector operations onto AltiVec/VSX builtins and Power-specific FPSCR manipulations where needed, providing the PowerPC-side inline semantics behind <smmintrin.h>.
